name: Nettersheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nettersheim (a black lion on yellow and a black cross on white above six white water-lily leaves on blue).
history: The lion comes from the arms of the Duchy of Jülich and the black cross from the Electorate of Cologne, while the six silver water-lily leaves on blue were the arms of the knights of Nechtersheim; the municipal flag was approved by the Oberkreisdirektor on 12 August 1974.

features.role: Nettersheim arms — lion, cross and water-lily leaves
